text:
clare.docs: opened PR #1300 to reconcile the quota and pricing docs for the new 'credits + throughput' model. A few broken dashboard links and old SDK header examples cropped up in the linkcheck. Diff: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1300

dave: can you summarize the required changes?

clare.docs: short list: (1) replace 'requests/min' with tokens->1k-token math, (2) update curl/Node/Python snippets to Authorization: Bearer, (3) add _redirects for three old anchors external sites still reference, (4) add a tiny FAQ clarifying burst credits vs sustained throughput.

mei: for SDK snippets please use responses.create in examples. Also add a one-line retry example for 429s that recommends exponential backoff using Retry-After when present.

clare.docs: added code updates. example curl snippet: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/responses \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-small","input":"hello"}'
```

dave: please add redirect lines to _redirects and ping support so they can map saved KB links. Use 301 for permanent changes.

clare.docs: added these redirect rules: ``#/help/pricing#old-tiers  /docs/quota#credits  301`` and ``#/dashboard/usage?panelId=33  /dashboards/usage?panelId=214  301``. pinged support with mappings.

devex-bot: preview build queued for branch docs/credits-throughput-migration. status: running linkcheck and snippet-sanity.

deploybot: preview build succeeded 1: https://deploy-preview-1300--docs.redwood.ai. Linkcheck passed; snippets render; redirects tested.

clare.docs: merging in 10m unless objections. will follow up with a changelog blurb and a short note to support & accounts. thanks!
